rationale.consistency: License header, index.Options.Flags reuse and wrapped errors match siblings; pointer-field config struct and raw syscall.Flock with no build tag are off-pattern for zoekt.
rationale.edge_cases: Duplicate names, non-directory roots, missing index dir and bare/worktree repos handled; remove silently matches nothing, corrupt shards are skipped silently, and dry run still mkdirs the index dir and creates a lock file.
rationale.scope: Focused on the new command plus the minimal gitindex change; IsUpToDate/prepareRepo extraction is justified for preview mode, no unrelated edits.
rationale.readability: main.go flow is clear; prepareRepo's manual closer-close-on-error and the shadowed err declarations are awkward, printHelp's io.Discard-then-SetOutput dance is odd, printHelp returns an always-nil error.
rationale.robustness: flock guards concurrent runs and preview never deletes; but os.Remove and ReadMetadataPath errors are swallowed, so failed prunes or unreadable shards go unreported, and the repo is opened twice per indexed repo.
rationale.maintainability: Discovery/inventory/lock split cleanly; -index flag defined three times, applyShardRemovals prints 'Pass -f' even when nothing to remove, and the Name=="" guard in SetTemplatesFromOrigin subtly changes semantics for any caller that pre-populates Name.
